issue_context.title: UCP: Migrate `dataForColumns` from package `infoschema` to `executor`
issue_context.body:
## Description

This is sub-task of https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/14828

The package `infoschema` should be used to store meta-information for virtual tables only.
But there is some retrieval data logic of the virtual table, which messes the `infoschema` .
PR #14704 has begun to migrate them. You can reference #14704 to help you migrate the `dataForColumns`.
